details.method: Before admitting paginated/range model context tools, measure underlying source body bytes and verification cost on every page and cold/warm range, not only serialized response bytes. Use bounded metadata and integrity-preserving verified reads with explicit source budgets.
details.when: A task-bound AI context adapter exposes immutable objects larger than each returned page/range from a host content store.
details.counterexample: Small tool responses can still trigger full-body reads on each page. Skipping whole-object integrity to reduce reads is not an acceptable optimization; cold verification may legitimately read a whole bounded object once.
details.trial_plan: Use the independent actual NativeStore 120x64KiB/two-page and2-byte-range reproduction. After repair require zero body reads for manifest pages, measured bounded first verification, no repeated whole-body verification for warm ranges, and rejection of corrupted/oversized/cross-tenant data; bind observations to exact repaired source.
